Class Validity.NoNulls

java.lang.Object
dev.hardwood.reader.Validity.NoNulls
All Implemented Interfaces:
Validity
Enclosing interface:
Validity
public static final class Validity.NoNulls extends Object implements Validity
Every item at this scope is non-null in the current batch. Use Validity.NO_NULLS — the constructor is private so identity comparison against the singleton is stable.

    • hasNulls

      public boolean hasNulls()
      Description copied from interface: Validity

      true iff at least one item at this scope is null in the current batch. O(1). May help on hot loops as a per-batch fast-path gate:

      if (!validity.hasNulls()) {
    // tight loop, no per-item check
} else {
    // checked loop
}
